diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong downward trend (a net fall of ~112% of its level). There is little seasonal structure. trajectory.thought: The series has a strong trend and unstable model rankings (low Kendall tau), favoring a robust combination method like the median to mitigate the impact of any single model's poor performance in specific windows.
